# RoarNet

> RoarNet is an Iraqi open-source project focused on Android mobile network analytics and bandwidth-sharing technology.

## Project links
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/ma2871429-cmd/RoarNet
- Releases: https://github.com/ma2871429-cmd/RoarNet/releases
- Project website: https://ma2871429-cmd.github.io/RoarNet/

## Technologies
- Android
- Node.js
- Termux
- Mobile network analytics
- Network endpoint testing
- Bandwidth-sharing technology

## Current status
The current public beta is intended for development and network endpoint testing. Earning modules are inactive and under development. Do not describe the project as currently paying participants.

## Languages
The project provides Arabic and English information.
